name: translation
description: Text translated from one language to another.

deliveryDays.description: Days from the start of the deal to delivery.

languages.description: Languages it is offered in, as BCP 47 tags such as en or es.

howDealsGo: The buyer pays into escrow at the start and releases when the translation arrives. Done is the whole text translated, accurate and in the agreed format. A timer to the seller, set past the due date, pays finished work if the buyer goes quiet. Before paying, say whether the translation must be certified.
